title: Enforce mc reminder delegation behavior
problem: Project manager handled tasks directly despite mc reminder intent. Need explicit enforcement and visible guardrails so focused work emits Task Packets instead of direct execution in PM thread.
fullPrompt: Implement and document enforcement rules so Project manager defaults to delegation for focused implementation work. Add clear guardrails in Master Control rules and operator instructions: when a focused task is detected, create packet-first output; when skipped, explicit exception line must appear. Validate with at least one reproducible scenario.
doneCriteria: Rules are explicit, packet-first behavior is documented and test scenario proves expected output pattern.
reportBack: Append summary to docs/master-control.md with enforcement changes and validation result.
modelReason: Narrow and well-scoped task where fast iteration is enough.
